method.generator: Twelve Codex subagents, fork_turns: none; one brief per fresh context, inherited session model and reasoning settings, no overrides.
method.model_metadata_note: The agent tools did not expose the exact model identifier or sampling parameters.
method.instructions: Complete portable RU or EN skill with its references, copied from dist after node scripts/prepare.mjs; source instructions unchanged from skill_source_commit.
method.requests: Six structure-* briefs in cases.json order, once per instruction edition. Generators received only one id/prompt pair and the corresponding portable skill, without checks or example_outputs.
method.tools: Local file reads and output writes only; no browsing, publication, external account actions or API-key setup.
method.judge: One independent fresh Codex subagent, /root/structure_behavior_judge; received only shuffled anonymous responses with briefs and checks, without the skill, instruction-edition labels, prior chat or examples.
method.judgment: Each check has pass, partial or fail plus evidence. Critical failures are recorded separately; the sample_id mapping to each instruction edition is preserved in samples.

fingerprints.portable: Hash the exact bytes of each portable file actually read by generators, without newline conversion or BOM insertion.
fingerprints.requests: Select structure-* cases in cases.json order, map to {id, prompt} in that property order, encode JSON.stringify(requests, null, 2) plus one LF as UTF-8, and hash those bytes.
fingerprints.response: Hash the original UTF-8 output-file bytes, preserved verbatim in response, including any final newline.
